cases.name: setting_ignored
cases.prompt: I set api_url in ~/.config/torc/config.toml but torc still hits localhost.
assertions: runs torc config paths to confirm which files are read
runs torc config show to see the effective value
lists the precedence order including TORC_API_URL and --url overriding the file
considers a project-local ./torc.toml overriding the user file

cases.name: runner_log_filter
cases.prompt: RUST_LOG=torc=debug works for torc status but torc run ignores it.
assertions: explains that torc run installs its own logger accepting only a bare level
notes the Invalid log level fallback to info
recommends --log-level debug or RUST_LOG=debug for the runner

cases.name: standalone_server_noise
cases.prompt: torc --log-level warn -s status 42 still prints [torc-server] INFO lines.
assertions: explains that the embedded server follows the [server] configuration, not the client flag
notes that those lines arrive on stderr

cases.name: custom_cluster_profile
cases.prompt: Torc does not know our cluster. Configure it so torc slurm generate works.
assertions: tries dynamic detection with torc hpc partitions slurm or torc hpc generate first
defines client.hpc.custom_profiles with partitions when needed
uses memory_mb and max_walltime_secs for partition limits
verifies with torc hpc match or a torc slurm generate dry run
